description.value: Kosoo Robson is a Korean fried chicken bar and casual dining restaurant situated along the bustling Robson Street corridor in downtown Vancouver, specializing in bone-in and boneless fried or oven-baked chicken in multiple sauces alongside traditional Korean BBQ and soul food. It is one of three Kosoo locations in the Vancouver area, each with a distinct menu focus. The restaurant offers dine-in with indoor seating and online ordering for takeout.
